blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The Department of Education (DepEd) Pagadian City Division has ordered a permanent tightening of campus security across the locality following an alleged online threat against local schools. Dr. Danny Cordova, DepEd Pagadian City Schools Division Superintendent, confirmed that on Wednesday evening, he received a report regarding a threat posted by a dummy social media account from Norberta National High School in Barangay Buenavista. He said the fake post warned students to avoid class on Thursday or they will be killed, adding that the alleged threat was intended to cause panic. READ: 3 minors charged over […]...
